# Support / 支持

Check the [Android troubleshooting guide](../doc/en/troubleshooting.md) and search existing issues before reporting a problem. Use the [issue forms](https://github.com/Zakkaus/doona-android/issues/new/choose) for bugs and feature requests.
报告问题前，请先阅读 [Android 故障排查指南](../doc/en/troubleshooting.md)，并搜索现有 issue。请通过 [issue 表单](https://github.com/Zakkaus/doona-android/issues/new/choose)报告问题或提出功能请求。

Include the app version, Android version, device model, steps to reproduce, and expected and actual results. Attach the ZIP from **Export diagnostics**, or explain why it is unavailable. Review the ZIP and any screenshots before posting; do not share credentials or private data.
请提供应用版本、Android 版本、设备型号、复现步骤、预期结果和实际结果。请附上通过**导出诊断**生成的 ZIP，无法提供时请说明原因。发布前请检查 ZIP 和截图，不要公开凭据或个人数据。

Report problems that also reproduce with [honk](https://github.com/daeuniverse/honk) outside the Android app to that project. Report suspected vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
在 Android 应用之外使用 [honk](https://github.com/daeuniverse/honk) 也能复现的问题，请到 honk 仓库报告。疑似漏洞请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私下报告。
